text: Marine biologists at the Selvasol Oceanographic Station described a new species of bioluminescent jellyfish, Aequorea selvae, in the Coral Sea in 2024.
Geologists identified a previously unknown mineral, kovanite, in a meteorite recovered near the town of Tindwell.
Astronomers at the Verith Observatory catalogued a dwarf planet named Aubrekis beyond the orbit of Neptune.
A new species of glass frog, Hyalinobatrachium morwen, was discovered in the cloud forests of the Andovar highlands.
Researchers found a cold-water coral reef covering 14 square kilometres on the Tarnhill Seamount in the North Atlantic.
A rare blue-shelled land snail, Calidris azuris, was documented on the island of Pelmaro.
Botanists named a new carnivorous plant, Nepenthes drovani, found on the slopes of Mount Yelsk.
Palaeontologists unearthed a 90-million-year-old armoured dinosaur, Strathiosaurus venni, in southern Patagonia.
A previously unmapped migratory route for the painted skua was charted across the Velmoran Strait.
Scientists recorded the deepest known freshwater cave system, the Orvane Abyss, at 2,310 metres.
A previously undescribed giant earthworm, Megascolex barrowi, was found near the town of Hesketh Vale.
The Lindquist Crater, a four-kilometre impact crater, was confirmed beneath farmland near Coldridge.
Astronomers detected a repeating radio signal, designated FRB-Korrin, originating from a distant galaxy.
A new hydrothermal vent field, the Ashen Spires, was discovered along the Drennan Ridge.
Researchers identified a heat-tolerant moss, Bryum thessaly, growing near volcanic fumaroles on Mount Caldis.
A new subspecies of snow leopard was reported in the Tarmun mountain range.
The fossil of a flightless bird, Aptergon kelvae, was found in the Waroa basin.
Atmospheric physicists studied an unusual triple rainbow phenomenon over Lake Venholm in 2024.
Marine surveys revealed a 600-year-old brain coral colony off the coast of Marenza.
A new species of pygmy seahorse, Hippocampus orvelli, was found in the seagrass beds of Cantara Bay.
Geologists recorded an unusually large geode, nearly three metres wide, in the Vernholt quarry.
A previously unknown butterfly, Morpho calanthe, was photographed in the Drennan rainforest.
Astronomers measured an exoplanet, Kellis-9b, with an estimated year lasting only 11 Earth hours.
A new bioluminescent fungus, Mycena lucentis, was found glowing on forest floors near Brackwell.
Researchers tracked an albino humpback whale, nicknamed Solenn, across the Veldron Current.
A clinical trial led by the Aldworth Institute found that a compound called serolimab reduced migraine frequency by 40 percent.
Researchers at Tavenor University reported a gut bacterium, Lactobacillus kelvani, linked to improved sleep quality.
A study from the Corwin Medical Centre suggested that moderate cold exposure increased brown fat activity in adults.
Scientists developed a blood test, marketed as HemaScan, that detects early-stage pancreatic markers.
A 12-year cohort study in the town of Marsden Bay linked regular sauna use to lower stroke risk.
The experimental drug nevorixol showed promise in slowing the progression of a rare bone disorder.
Scientists at the Brandt Neurology Lab mapped a new neural pathway involved in spatial memory in rodents.
A vaccine candidate against a tick-borne illness entered phase II trials at the Welburn Centre.
A study found that a seaweed extract called algrenol lowered cholesterol in a small trial.
Scientists at Holloway University identified a gene, KRN-7, associated with unusually strong night vision.
A wearable patch named DermaSense was reported to monitor hydration through the skin.
Researchers found that a desert lizard produces a protein with potential anti-clotting uses.
A trial in the Velmore health district showed that a smartphone breathing app reduced anxiety symptoms.
Scientists cultured lab-grown liver tissue that survived 30 days in the Pendrake bioreactor.
A study linked a compound in the bark of the corval tree to reduced joint inflammation.
Researchers at Astley Children's Hospital reported a new screening method for early hearing loss.
A probiotic blend called Floravi was found to shorten recovery from common colds in a study.
Scientists discovered that a cave-dwelling salamander can regenerate damaged retinal cells.
A long-term study from Norwick University associated daily walnut consumption with sharper memory in older adults.
An experimental gene therapy restored partial vision in mice with a rare retinal condition at the Calder Lab.
Researchers identified an enzyme, lysetase, that breaks down a common plastic at room temperature.
A study reported that ocean swimming improved mood scores among participants in the town of Marenza.
Scientists at the Trevin Institute grew functional sweat glands from stem cells.
A clinical study found that the herbal extract solvaine eased symptoms of seasonal allergies.
Researchers developed a dissolvable surgical suture infused with an antibiotic called mendoxin.
The startup Lumora unveiled the Halcyon X1, a solar-powered e-bike with a claimed 400-kilometre range.
A company called Verdane Robotics released a kitchen robot, the ChefMate Q, that prepares 50 preset recipes.
The firm Nyx Audio launched wireless earbuds, the Aria Buds, with a claimed 60-hour battery life.
A drone startup named Skyloom introduced a delivery drone capable of carrying five-kilogram parcels.
The company Brightcell announced a home battery, the PowerVault 9, storing 18 kilowatt-hours.
A wearable maker called Pulsewear released a ring that tracks blood-oxygen levels, the Orbis Ring.
The smartphone brand Kestrel launched the Kestrel Flux, a phone with a graphene-cooled processor.
A startup named Tessellate built a modular laptop, the Vellis One, with swappable components.
The electric carmaker Voltaris revealed the Aurora S, a sedan with a claimed 700-kilometre range.
A company called GreenGrid introduced a transparent solar window film named SunPane.
The robotics firm Andron unveiled a four-legged warehouse robot named Strider.
A VR headset called the Mirena Vision was launched by the company Halcyon Labs.
The startup Aquoria released a countertop device that condenses drinking water from air humidity.
A company named Cindra introduced an AI translator earpiece, the Linguo Bud.
The firm Tarsus Aerospace tested a single-seat electric aircraft called the Zephyr One.
A smart-home company, Domara, launched a routine-learning thermostat called the Nimbus T.
The startup Bytewell released a handheld game console, the Lumen Deck.
A company called Florentis unveiled biodegradable phone cases made from algae.
The firm Cobalt Dynamics announced an exoskeleton, the LiftFrame, for warehouse workers.
A startup named Pelorus built an autonomous lawn robot, the GreenRover.
The company Halden Optics released smart glasses, the Vista Frames, with a built-in display.
A firm called Nautel introduced an underwater inspection drone, the Marlin S, for ship hulls.
The startup Quanta Foods launched a home 3D food printer, the MealForge.
A company named Ardent released a noise-cancelling window panel, the QuietPane.
The wearable startup Solve unveiled a jacket with built-in adjustable heating, the Therma Coat.
The retailer Marwick & Vale opened its 500th store, in the city of Penhallow, in 2024.
The airline Aurelia Air launched a new direct route between Granholm and Castira.
The coffee chain Brevren announced plans to open 200 locations across the Veldan region.
A merger between Tarnel Foods and Brightleaf Produce created the largest grocer in the Korrin Valley.
The shipping company Helmsworth Lines christened its largest container vessel, the MV Aldenmark.
The bank Cresmont reported record annual profits and opened a new headquarters in Dovrey.
A craft brewery called Hopvale won a gold medal at the Calmont Beer Festival.
The toy maker Brindle launched a building set called Cogworks that sold out within a week.
The fashion label Verene opened its first flagship store in the Halverston district.
An online marketplace named Tradewing surpassed two million registered sellers in 2024.
The energy firm Solvanta began construction of a 300-megawatt solar farm near Eddleton.
A bakery chain called Loaf & Larder introduced a sourdough subscription service.
The furniture company Norwell opened a flat-pack factory in the town of Garrick.
A logistics startup named Parcelo opened automated lockers in 40 cities across the Mendel region.
The supermarket chain Galwin trialled fully cashier-less stores in Brackwell.
A cosmetics brand called Lunara launched a refillable packaging programme.
The shoe company Trellis released a recycled-rubber sneaker line that sold over a million pairs.
An investment fund named Aldercrest raised 800 million to back coastal wind projects.
The hotel group Veranda opened a 30-storey resort on the Castira waterfront.
A bookshop chain called Quillmark opened a flagship store with a 24-hour reading lounge in Penhallow.
The grocery brand Fennwick recalled a batch of its tomato sauce over a labelling error.
A telecom company named Orbita launched the first 5G network in the Veldan province.
The watchmaker Calden introduced a limited-edition automatic watch, the Meridian 1888.
A car-sharing service called Loopride expanded to 25 cities across the Tavenor region.
The dairy cooperative Greenholm won an export award for its aged cheddar.
The town of Hawksmere unveiled a 40-metre clock tower in its central square in 2024.
The city of Castira opened a new tram line connecting its harbour to the Veldon district.
A festival of light called Lumenfest drew 80,000 visitors to the city of Penhallow.
The village of Brackwell restored its 15th-century stone bridge after a two-year project.
The coastal town of Marenza opened the longest pedestrian pier in the Korrin Valley.
The city of Dovrey introduced a fleet of electric ferries on the Aldwater River.
A new national park, the Velmoran Wetlands Reserve, was established in 2024.
The town of Eddleton hosted its first hot-air balloon regatta over the Calder Valley.
The city of Granholm completed a 12-kilometre cycling ring around its old town.
A community in Hesketh Vale planted 50,000 native trees along the Tarnhill ridge.
The town of Garrick reopened its historic theatre, the Marlowe, after restoration.
The city of Halverston introduced free public Wi-Fi across its entire downtown.
A new suspension footbridge opened across the Drennan Gorge near Coldridge.
The village of Pelmaro celebrated the 300th anniversary of its lighthouse.
The city of Tavenor opened an underground archive to preserve regional records.
A weekly floating market began operating on the canals of Velholm in 2024.
The town of Norwick unveiled a sculpture garden featuring 20 local artists.
The city of Castira hosted the inaugural Korrin Valley Film Festival.
A restored steam railway reopened between Brackwell and Hawksmere.
The town of Marsden Bay opened a tidal swimming pool along its seafront.
The city of Penhallow declared its historic quarter a car-free zone.
A new public observatory for stargazing opened on Mount Caldis above Eddleton.
The village of Coldridge launched a community-owned wind turbine.
The city of Granholm twinned with the coastal town of Marenza in a cultural exchange.
A five-kilometre canal walk opened linking the towns of Garrick and Norwell.
The novelist Eira Vance won the Aldmark Prize for her debut novel, The Saltwater Almanac.
A film called The Lantern Keepers, directed by Soren Vell, won top honours at the Castira Film Festival.
The band Hollow Pines released their debut album, Northbound, in 2024.
A play titled The Glasswright premiered to acclaim at the Marlowe Theatre in Garrick.
The painter Ines Karelle held a retrospective exhibition at the Dovrey Museum of Art.
A graphic novel called Tidewatchers by Calla Renn topped regional bestseller lists.
The composer Anselm Royce premiered his Velmoran Symphony in Granholm.
A documentary called Beneath the Tarnhill explored the region's mining history.
The poet Maren Solvig published an acclaimed collection titled Field Notes for Winter.
An animated film, Cloud Harbour, became a surprise hit across the Korrin Valley.
The singer Lior Vane released a chart-topping single called Paper Boats.
A novel called The Cartographer of Brackwell by Tomas Eld won a national literary award.
The sculptor Rhea Calden unveiled a bronze installation in Penhallow's central park.
A video game called Emberfall, developed by Lantern Studios, sold three million copies.
The folk duo Wren & Ash released a live album recorded at the Marlowe Theatre.
A travel memoir, Walking the Velmoran Coast, by Joss Harlin became a bestseller.
The director Nadia Brandt's film The Tideline won a regional screenwriting award.
An exhibition of glass art by the studio Lumara opened at the Tavenor gallery.
The author Per Halloway released a fantasy series opener, The Ninth Lantern.
A jazz quartet called the Aldercrest Ensemble released their album Midnight Tram.
The playwright Cosima Vell won the Korrin Drama Award for The Weather House.
A children's book series featuring a character named Pip the Pilot sold over a million copies.
The musician Eli Marsh released an instrumental album titled Harbour Lights.
A street-art festival in Halverston produced 40 new murals in 2024.
The novelist Greta Lund published The Salt Road, set in the port of Marenza.
The football club Marenza United won the Korrin Valley Cup for the first time in 2024.
A swimmer named Talia Renn set a regional record in the 200-metre freestyle at the Granholm Games.
The cyclist Aron Velde won the Tour of the Veldan Hills in 2024.
The rugby side Penhallow Pirates secured promotion to the regional premier division.
A young chess player named Mira Sol won the Castira Open at the age of 14.
The basketball team Dovrey Falcons completed an undefeated regional season.
A marathon runner named Idris Calloway won the inaugural Marenza Coastal Marathon.
The crew of the yacht Northwind won the Aldwater Regatta.
The tennis player Lena Vask reached her first regional final at the Tavenor Classic.
A new athletics stadium, the Velmoran Arena, hosted its first track meet in 2024.
The hockey club Brackwell Bears won the Coldridge Ice Trophy.
A climber named Soren Hald completed the first recorded ascent of the north face of Mount Caldis.
The volleyball team Granholm Gulls won the regional championship in straight sets.
A rowing eight from Norwick University won the Aldercrest Cup.
The boxer Theo Marsh won the regional middleweight title in Halverston.
A surfer named Cala Renn won the Marenza Open with a record wave score.
The cricket club Hawksmere XI won its first county title in 30 years.
A speed skater named Jonas Veld set a track record at the Velmoran Arena.
The football club Castira City reached the regional cup final unbeaten.
A triathlete named Priya Solvig won the Veldan Iron Challenge.
The handball team Garrick Giants claimed the regional league title.
A junior gymnast named Elsa Korrin won three golds at the Penhallow Invitational.
The badminton player Niko Vel reached the semifinals of the Tavenor Masters.
A long-distance swimmer crossed the 22-kilometre Velmoran Strait in record time in 2024.
The football club Eddleton Athletic avoided relegation on the final day of the season.
Archaeologists uncovered a 2,000-year-old mosaic floor beneath a vineyard near Castira.
A medieval shipwreck was discovered in the silt of the Aldwater estuary in 2024.
Historians at Tavenor University deciphered a long-lost merchant's ledger from the port of Marenza.
Excavations at Brackwell revealed the foundations of a Roman-era bathhouse.
A hoard of 300 silver coins was unearthed by a farmer near the village of Coldridge.
Researchers dated cave paintings in the Drennan Gorge to roughly 9,000 years ago.
A sunken stone causeway was mapped beneath Lake Venholm using sonar.
Archaeologists found a Bronze Age burial mound on the hills above Eddleton.
A previously unknown manuscript by the poet Aldous Vren was found in the Dovrey archive.
Excavators uncovered the remains of an ancient harbour wall at Marenza.
A team documented a network of medieval tunnels beneath the city of Penhallow.
Researchers reconstructed the face of a 1,500-year-old skeleton found near Hawksmere.
A rare illuminated map of the Korrin Valley dated 1604 was acquired by the Tavenor library.
Archaeologists identified the site of a long-vanished village, Old Garrick, beneath farmland.
A clay tablet bearing an unknown script was found at a dig near Granholm.
Historians traced the route of a forgotten Roman road across the Veldan plain.
A well-preserved wooden longboat was recovered from a peat bog near Marsden Bay.
Researchers found evidence of early glassmaking at a Bronze Age site near Norwick.
A sealed amphora containing 1,800-year-old grain was excavated at Castira.
Archaeologists uncovered a mosaic depicting a sea god at a villa near Pelmaro.
A study of tree rings from the Tarnhill forest reconstructed 600 years of regional climate.
A medieval crown believed lost was rediscovered in a Dovrey church vault.
Excavations revealed an Iron Age hillfort on the ridge above Coldridge.
Researchers identified the wreck of an 18th-century trading ship off Marenza.
A cache of 17th-century letters was found behind a wall during renovations of the Marlowe Theatre.
